notes: Heights from the Wikipedia list of tallest buildings in Kuala Lumpur (standard height measurement: spires and architectural details included, antennas excluded; the page cites CTBUH for its rankings), fetched on the date above. Matched to OSM buildings by OSM name. Where a building is drawn as OSM building:parts (the Petronas Towers), the parts keep their own OSM heights and the cited value is recorded on the outline. Stated floor counts are converted with storeyHeights (3.5 m default; 5.0 m for mall retail floors, the same assumption as for the Mid Valley malls).
